images.alt:
An event venue should give you more than four walls.

For Malaysian Bridal Fashion Week, CCEC’s versatile spaces were transformed to serve every part of the experience, from exhibition booths and bridal showcases to activations and guest areas.

Our Grand Nexus Ballroom was reimagined as a full-scale fashion runway, while the rest of the venue continued the experience beyond the show.

Thank you @malaysiabridalfashionweek and @thegownatelier for bringing the vision to life with us at Connexion Conference & Event Centre
images.heading: connexioncec

images.alt:
A look back at Malaysian Bridal Fashion Week’s main showcase at CCEC.

Our space was transformed into a runway, with collections taking centre stage and every element coming together to create an atmosphere shaped entirely around the occasion.

From an open event floor to a fully realised fashion showcase, it was a reminder that a space doesn’t have to stay one way.

It can become whatever your occasion calls for.
images.heading: connexioncec

images.alt:
It was a pleasure to have hosted Malaysian Bridal Fashion Week at Connexion Conference & Event Centre.

With a series of showcases, vendors and experiences unfolding across the venue, the event brought our spaces to life in different ways giving guests room to move, discover and experience the week at their own pace.

Thank you @malaysiabridalfashionweek for choosing CCEC as the setting for this celebration of bridal fashion.
